findings.text: neither the station-gap nor the station-stale event has a branch in the consumer loop, so a text pane renders them through format_watch_transition, which ignores the "line" field; a direct probe of that call on the head revision returns '--:--:--  ?          unknown                              new -> halted            -   0w  0h  0d  0q'. The plan's skip line and stale-heartbeat line are therefore unmet for the human pane, and the tests at tests/test_a_follower_is_a_station_subscriber.py:163 and :189 pass anyway because they assert the event payload rather than the printed output.

_cap_history duplicates reckon/crew/follow_checkpoint.py:416 cap_history (same arguments, same window-then-count trim, differing only in tolerating a missing "at" key), so one trimming rule now has two owners; it duplicates rather than wraps or extends the existing owner.

_StationRegistration.held returns True unconditionally, so on the subscriber path a second follower claiming the same session is never detected and both write the same cursors row, where the producer path it replaces refuses the second holder through the advisory lock in reckon/crew/follower_registration.py:389.

the recorded trace names /crew/watch and /crew/live as well as the two lease files, so the done_when's "names no path under the crew home other than those two lease files" is met in substance but not as literally written.
